text:
jen: Heads-up — Nimbus Analytics' VRM sent the SIG-RA questionnaire back. They want per-question evidence attachments and a CSV mapping. Target date = end of week. Can we split tasks?

mike: I can take questions in the infra & network sections (network isolation, VPC peering, ingress controls).

ana: I'll take encryption, key management, and log retention policies. Also will run redaction on any logs.

jen: Great. @rick you're on SOC2/ISO certs and subprocessors?

rick: Yep. I'll gather dated PDFs and include vendor attestations. Also need to confirm whether Nimbus requires a signed SOC2 — they asked for vendor evidence and dates.

ana: For KMS evidence, I'll include KMS policy JSON, HSM attestation snippet, and rotation audit. Want those in raw JSON + short note for mapping.

mike: For infra artifacts, I'll produce: topology diagram (aws-regions + AZ mapping), security group export, and runtime conf showing tenant isolation.

jen: They asked specifically for per-question filenames formatted like: question-1_2_3.pdf and a CSV with columns: question_id, artifact_path, description.

mike: Sounds good. I'll export security groups and a sanitized netflow sample.

ana: Reminder: scrub IPs and user identifiers from netflow and audit logs before upload. I'll run `tools/redact-logs --pii` before staging.

jen: Use bucket s3://redwood-vrm-uploads/nimbus/ and put files under section/question-id/ e.g. `s3://redwood-vrm-uploads/nimbus/cryptography/2.1/`. Pre-signed links ok (7 day expiry).

rick: I'll add `subprocessors.csv` and `soc2-certified-Vendors/` with cert PDFs.

mike: Posting quick export command I'm going to run for infra artifacts:
```
# infra export for Nimbus SIG
redwoodctl sig-export --customer nimbus --sections infra,network,auth --out s3://redwood-vrm-uploads/nimbus/export-2025-04-01/ --redact none
```

ana: For crypto I'll run the rotation proof export with redaction:
```
redwoodctl keys export-rotation --since 2024-01-01 --customer nimbus --outfile /tmp/rotation.json && tools/redact-logs /tmp/rotation.json --remove-ips > /tmp/rotation-redacted.json
```

jen: One ask from their VRM: they want evidence attached to each SIG question where relevant; do not send a single monolith. They will ingest into their GRC.

mike: Understood. I'll create small PDFs per question (diagram + 1 paragraph).

rick: Legal note from Tom: they asked about EU residency controls for EU tenants. We need audit traces showing regional routing + a short legal-approved statement. Tom, can you draft?

jen: Pinged Tom.

ana: I'll include region-tagged audit logs trimmed to the relevant traces and sanitized.

evidence-bot: mapping file created: s3://redwood-vrm-uploads/nimbus/mapping/nimbus-sig-mapping-20250401.csv (:package:)

jen: Nice. @evidence-bot can you also generate pre-signed links and post them here when ready?

evidence-bot: presigned links generated for 7 days. Link manifest: s3://redwood-vrm-uploads/nimbus/presigned-links-20250401.txt

mike: Uploaded infra diagrams to `s3://redwood-vrm-uploads/nimbus/infra/1.1/topology-az.png` and `.../network/1.3/security-groups-export.json`.

ana: Uploaded redacted rotation logs: `s3://redwood-vrm-uploads/nimbus/cryptography/2.1/rotation-20250401-redacted.json`

rick: Uploaded SOC2 pdfs to `s3://redwood-vrm-uploads/nimbus/compliance/soc2-2023.pdf` and `s3://redwood-vrm-uploads/nimbus/subprocessors/subprocessors-20250401.csv`

jen: Thanks. Two remaining items: 1) Tom to post the legal residency blurb; 2) confirm a short walkthrough call after they ingest. Nimbus asked for a quick 30-min walkthrough.

mike: I can do the walkthrough. Morning PT works for me.

ana: I can join for crypto/logging Qs.

tom: Drafted residency statement and uploaded to `s3://redwood-vrm-uploads/nimbus/legal/residency-statement-20250401.pdf` — note: legal wants the call to cover interpretive Qs only.

jen: Perfect. I'll assemble the CSV mapping final version and drop pre-signed links in an email to Nimbus VRM. Leave a note here when you upload any late artifacts.

mike: Done. All infra artifacts uploaded. Mapping CSV updated with infra rows.

ana: Crypto & logs done and referenced in mapping CSV.

rick: Compliance artifacts done. Added cert expiration dates to mapping notes.

evidence-bot: final mapping updated: s3://redwood-vrm-uploads/nimbus/mapping/nimbus-sig-mapping-20250401-final.csv (:package:)

jen: Sending email to Nimbus VRM with presigned links + invite for 30m walkthrough (proposed times attached). I'll CC security and legal.

mike: Thanks team. Good job moving fast.

jen: Closing owners: mike (infra), ana (security/crypto), rick (compliance), tom (legal). Any blockers shout here.

ana: No blockers on my side — redaction script found one user-id in logs and removed.

rick: No blockers. All certs current.

mike: One note: the netflow sample we uploaded is aggregated 24h — customer asked whether we can provide a 7-day sample if they need deeper inspection. I'll wait for their request.

jen: Noted. We'll treat that as follow-up. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
